card.text: Explore Nix through the measured New Horizons shape model.

introduction.text: Nix is a small moon orbiting the Pluto–Charon pair. New Horizons resolved its elongated shape and a reddish region around a large crater. The moon spins much faster than it circles the system; it keeps no single face turned toward Pluto.

model.title: Porter shape reconstruction
model.summary: A New Horizons shape fit. The released mesh lacks image registration; gray grid: no mapped imagery.
